hero.subtitle: Explore MBBS Opportunities in Russia 2026–2027. NMC & WHO recognized government medical universities with 100% English medium instruction.

overview: Russia has become one of the most preferred destinations for Indian students who want to study MBBS abroad because of its high-quality education, affordable tuition fees, and globally recognized medical universities. With a course duration of around 6 years, MBBS in Russia offers the perfect combination of theoretical learning and practical clinical exposure in modern government hospitals.

faq.question: Is NEET mandatory for MBBS in Russia?
faq.answer: Yes, qualifying NEET in the year of admission or preceding two years is mandatory as per NMC guidelines for Indian students.

faq.question: Is the MBBS degree from Russia recognized in India?
faq.answer: Yes, all our partner medical universities comply fully with NMC gazette guidelines, making graduates eligible for the NExT/FMGE licensing examination.

faq.question: What is the medium of instruction for MBBS in Russia?
faq.answer: The entire 6-year MBBS curriculum is taught in English medium for international students.

faq.question: Are hostel and Indian mess facilities available in Russia?
faq.answer: Yes, universities provide safe on-campus hostels with round-the-clock security and Indian food messes serving vegetarian and non-vegetarian meals.
